name: Fade Curve Transition
description: A cross-fade whose speed depends on how different the clips are at each pixel and channel: `curve` 0 fades the differing parts early (fast), 1 late (slow). Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: curve
params.description: 0 = fadefast (pixels that differ a lot switch to the second clip sooner), 1 = fadeslow (later)
